materials: Silver with a gold band, encased in a kamagong box lined with green gamosa
description:
While a student at the Universidad de Santo Tomas in 1879, Jose Rizal joined a poetry contest organized by the Liceo Artistico de Manila and was awarded this quill for his poem, “A La Juventud Filipina” [To the Filipino Youth].

Encased in a kamagong box with green gamosa lining, the silver quill has a liceo inscription on its gold band. It is in good condition, despite three missing feathers, some corrosion, and minor restoration.
condition: Good condition, despite three missing feathers, some corrosion, and minor restoration.
